0022600176.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-5, on a four-game losing streak and 1.5 games back in the Southeast) visit the Brooklyn Nets (1-6, on a one-game losing streak and 5.5 games back in the Atlantic) in a matchup of teams sitting 9th and 15th in the East. Charlotte is without Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, who are both out with hamstring injuries, and Coby White is day-to-day with a calf injury and a game-time decision, while Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), both out. The Hornets lead this season's series 1-0 after a 110-103 win in Brooklyn, and they also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
